characterization_split.purpose: Donor circuit discovery, native causal localization, recipient pathway probing
characterization_split.leakage_boundary: Must NOT be used to report final transfer accuracy or generalization

validation_split.purpose: Hyperparameter optimization, two-branch adapter training, finite-difference verification
validation_split.leakage_boundary: Must NOT be used to choose final transfer claim thresholds

heldout_test_split.purpose: Final out-of-distribution transfer evaluation, exact token agreement, restoration tests
heldout_test_split.leakage_boundary: NEVER touched during training, circuit selection, or tuning

disjointness_guarantee: Strict disjoint set verification: len(characterization intersect validation) == 0, len(characterization intersect heldout) == 0, len(validation intersect heldout) == 0.
